reviews.text: Like Most of It But…. I like the videos, I think they’re extensive and the cost of the subscription aligns with the amount and variety of resources. However, I wish we got a reminder email before a yearly subscription renews. Turns out I had the date wrong and I got charged $130 when I was planning on taking a break from the subscription because I need new tires. Used to get multiple email reminders ahead of renewal. Buyer beware- place a reminder in your calendar.

Happy user. I am very grateful for this app. Note that this app is really meant for subscribers. The only real downside for me is wanting to spend time in the community section, but at the same time knowing it is still social media. It’s still taking me away from real life. But I do like the connections. It’s a supportive community of wonderful people. Beyond that, the resources for yoga along with bonus fitness, meditation, soundbath, breath work options is wonderful! And ad free of course. Some in this community seem to get frustrated with change. I’m guessing it’s a vocal minority being a squeaky wheel. Yes there are bugs, but they listen to the users and work things out in a respectable amount of time
Appmageddon. FWFG trashed the app two months ago and started from scratch. The new platform is a disaster. The communication has been dismissive and fixes are nonexistent.

New Updates. Unfortunately the new updates on this app have removed some benefits for members. You now have to navigate between the website and the app to access both calendars instead of combining the two like before. I have contacted customer service and they just give me links to both. Its annoying.

The Best. This app is incredible! Yoga for literally everything with kindness and compassion. It makes me feel more relaxed and it’s always there for you through it all. It’s a great place to find some peace and take time for yourself.
Updates have made this almost useless. The updates have removed base functionality that users loved and used frequently. Support does not answer emails.
App seems buggy. I used it last year and rejoined Again this month. Seems the buttons on the screen like back and airplay won’t respond. If I leave full screen it works.

Life changing!. A fantastic app with a wide variety of yoga and meditation sessions. The monthly calendar makes it so easy to follow pre-planned session and buying the membership gives extras like early access to new classes. No matter my mood, I can find classes that meet it challenging to restorative. Can sort and search by area of focus (ouch, my pesky shoulders!), duration, instructor, etc. New updates make it even more user-friendly.

Love the yoga but not the app update. The recent app update, for Apple TV anyway, removed the collections by length, which I used a lot. It’s also harder to read how long each session is due to the black on dark grey. Hope you’ll fix this! It at least loaded much more quickly/didn’t seem to get stuck scrolling down the screen.

Don’t bother without a subscription. There’s no way that I can find to filter or search for the free videos. And every video I’ve tried prompts me to subscribe before I can watch it. This is useless without signing up for the subscription.

Nothing but problems. The app worked seamlessly for the last couple years, now nothing but problems whether using my Android device or my MacBook Pro. On the Android, videos will freeze, so it’s unusable. On my MacBook, I’m not even able to scroll the length of the page or see all my curated playlists I’ve spent the last few years making. The content itself is 5 stars, the app itself -5.

Medicine For The Soul. In a landscape saturated with fitness and wellness apps that often tout the latest trends or promote a one-size-fits-all approach, Find What Feels Good (FWFG) stands out by prioritizing authenticity and accessibility. This app isn't about chasing fleeting trends or creating an illusion of perfection it's about honoring individual needs, feelings, and realities.

What truly sets FWFG apart is its emphasis on genuine connection. The platform offers a diverse array of practices from yoga and meditation to movement and self-care that are rooted in realness. The instructors and content creators come across as approachable, relatable, and committed to sharing practices that support real lives, not just curated images or idealized lifestyles. This creates a welcoming environment where users can feel safe to explore their own wellness journey without judgment or pressure.

Accessibility is woven into the fabric of the app. Whether you're a beginner or have been practicing for years, FWFG offers content that is inclusive and adaptable. You don’t need fancy equipment or a specific space many sessions are designed to be practiced anywhere and at any level. The emphasis is on feeling good in your body and mind, not fitting into a certain aesthetic or achieving a perfect pose.

Moreover, the community aspect fosters a sense of connection rather than competition. The focus on self-awareness and self-care over superficial trends makes FWFG a refreshing alternative to more superficial wellness platforms. It encourages users to listen to their own bodies and feelings, making wellness a truly personal and accessible experience.

In summary, Find What Feels Good champions realness and accessibility in a crowded market. It’s an inviting space where genuine self-care is prioritized over trendy appearances, making wellness approachable and sustainable for all.

Glitchy app. The app is glitchy and requires monthly subscription. Community fawns all over it instead of expecting it to work well. I was happy paying for it when new content was made for free to non subscribers weekly but now that’s like monthly… if you’re going to charge, provide functionality as expected

Videos are great. App is terrible.. I honestly don’t know why I pay $100 a year for access to this. I often find myself just going to YouTube because the app will not play videos Just now. I was in a playlist for videos and got a message that I was not able to view a video, but when I searched for the same video in the app itself, it played fine. It’s really disappointing.
My Favorite Yoga App and Instructor. This app is so amazing! I love all that Adrienne does- she has helped me start and maintain my yoga practice. Her classes always feel like safe places to be! ❤️

Save your money. Don’t get the app, the app is garbage.

Just do the videos for free on YouTube.

The app is total garbage.

New app made me cancel longstanding subscription. I cancelled my longstanding subscription a couple weeks ago because the new app is so bad on my [new and updated] iPad. Everything is weirdly sized…elements cover other elements during replay. Ugh. It’s such a shame! The content is so good!

I understand the objective to create a bigger community focus, but the main purpose of this app is ultimately the easy and intuitive access of a large video library. I’m not sure what happened or what decisions were made during the revamp, but the app is now *less* useful and *less* intuitive than it was before with regards to its main purpose. That’s not good.

Disappointed by Bait n’ Switch. I did a free trial in late August, and I loved using the app to track my daily practice. Shortly after I paid for a full year subscription, the whole platform changed and the calendar is now useless. I wouldn’t have subscribed without that feature, and I haven’t used the app since.
New update broken (crash on opening). Please repair the new update. It crashes when it lowers. I just updated this app and it no longer works. I've tried everything. So sad

Not a fan of the new app. I really love YWA and used to love this app and use it every day. But now with the new design it’s difficult to find what I want, chaotic, and sadly I’ve noticed myself doing less yoga or feeling less motivated to do yoga every day because of the hassle of using the new app. Please bring back the old format or at least an option to have the old version. 🙏🏻

Love the Content, New App Needs Improvements. I keep looking for an update on this app because, with the update, everything is clunky. Titles don’t fit on screens so it’s possible to quickly scroll for content. It seems like everything is oversized. Can’t wait for a fix so it goes back to being great content AND a great app!
Crashes everyday. It crashes every day but I love the content

Adrienne great, no support for app issues. I have been doing yoga with Adriene for several years and absolutely adore her videos. They are incredible and I have absolutely no complaints about the content. My issue is that I can’t turn the subtitles on the app off. I know how to do it, but when I select “none” the app still shows subtitles, which I find distracting to the point that I can’t use the videos on the app and have to go back to YouTube. I have tried erasing and redownloading the app, turning my phone off and back in again, selecting several different videos…nothing works. I contacted support and have received none.
Concern for the FWFG APP. Does anyone know how to make an account on this app, because I couldn’t seem to find the create account button
No features for the unregistered. Absolutely no usefulness for those who don’t want to register with all their personal details and presumably currency

Well worth it!. I started subscribing to FWFG during 2020 and have never looked back. I never want to be without Yoga With Adriene again, and this is a fantastic app to make that happen. This year’s January challenge is better than ever, and using the app is so much better than going through the free options on YouTube. Highly recommend!

Love the new update!. My favorite exercise and meditation app and teachers ever, and LOVE the newest update, much more intuitive and reliable structure and search features- love it and love Adriene & the team who put this app together for easy access to yoga and teachings with no ads or empty distractions ♥️

The best. I started doing Yoga With Adriene videos on YouTube about a year ago. I liked them so much I eventually paid for a FWFG membership to show my support. I thought I would still mostly use YouTube but the app is actually very nice, it provides everything I need and nothing I don’t. I particularly appreciate that there is an Apple TV app. As Adriene always says, getting started is the hardest part, so being able to fire up a video on my tv without having to fiddle around with an iPad or search through a distracting YouTube interface is very nice. 

Adriene’s videos feel like a philosophy lesson, a chat with a loving friend, and a nice workout all in one. They’ve kept me engaged longer than any other exercise program I’ve ever tried. Don’t chase fast results. Be present with the videos, be kind to yourself, try to do a little every day, and with time you will see enormous growth in yourself physically, mentally and spiritually.

Only yoga for me in my lifetime is with Adriene & Benji. I have been watching yoga with Adriene for 8+ years… My cable guy told me about it, and I have been hooked… I was even blessed to practice yoga with everyone at red rocks here in Colorado a couple years ago… This year there for all levels, great meditations, and communication every day! I just can’t say enough wonderful things about what they all do, and about how much fun Adriene is to be with every day - I love you all who “are” Yoga With Adriene ❤️ 🧘‍♀️

Adriene and Benji have changed my life ❤️. The day I turned 30, I did Adriene’s first 30
Day challenge. I’m 36 and have kept a daily practice since that birthday. It’s difficult for me to put my gratitude into words. I don’t know where I would be without my home practice that Adriene has inspired me to have. Most of her content is 100% free (!!!) and I also have her incredibly affordable membership (I pay $10 a month, which is less than a single yoga class at a studio) that has members-only content and more focused/advanced practices. She has a way of making yoga sustainable, accessible, and deeply loving. Her practices are my safe space, my joy, my anchor, and the backbone of my being. All that to say, if you’re looking for an app that just might change your life, this is the one.

Love the app and her. You can get most of it for free on YouTube. However it’s worthwhile paying the little bit extra a month. I have been following her for years and she is the most genuine person. Love her programs and her app works great.

My go to for yoga. Absolutely LOVE Find What Feels Good. Very well put together app that allows you to sort and find ANY type of yoga you may need/want based on difficulty, location of interest, length, style, etc and she has several hundred videos to choose from. Adriene is the best at being her authentic self and carries that warmth, humility, humor and joy onto the mat. PLUS you get Benji, and as someone who practices at home with their doggos, who can really have too much Benji? Worth every penny, even got my husband doing regular yoga and loving it!

The Best. I came to Adriene 2 1/2 years ago and signed up for membership shortly thereafter. She is amazing and the app is fantastic. Everything I need for every day and every mood. It’s really the best!
Worth it. This helped take my practice with Adriene to the next level…additional members only videos, easier to plan, search and navigate, and no commercials. Cheers!

Adrienne is LOVE. Yoga with Adrienne is the best yoga experience I’ve had. I have practiced yoga for over 40 years and have completed yoga teacher training. My home practice came to life when I discovered yoga with Adrienne. The videos were recommended to me by my therapist during the pandemic.

She is an excellent instructor and being a member allows one to gain a deeper understanding of a yoga practice. The monthly Vlogs are inspirational and heartfelt. During the videos Adrienne often says ‘I love you guys’ and I feel that across and through cyberspace. Adrienne has helped me maintain physical and mental health. Her spirit brings joy into my life. Adrienne is loved by many, I’m honored to be one of the millions who call her their teacher.

Thank you Adrienne.

Love!. I’ve been practicing with the FWFG community for years and I love it! I live in a rural area, so access to in-person yoga is pretty limited. Through this app I get to connect with other and grow my practice!

Always with me. I got a FindWhatFeelsGood membership as a birthday present, and have renewed it ever since. I love having yoga with Adriene with me anytime anyplace. I use it when I wake up feeling off or down. I use it when I feel sick. I use it as daily self care. I use I when I feel vertigo coming on. I use it when I have a headache. I use it to change my perspective or to find love. It’s a foundation in my every day.
Thank you Adrian

A wonderful internet space. I love the FWFG app experience. It is organized nicely and I have benefited from the app exclusive videos. Sumair helped me with back pain in the rewiring the upper body video. Also love that it allows us a space to thank the Yoga With Adriene team for all they do to provide free yoga access to all on YouTube with reasonable monthly fee for the app.

A Gift. Adriene is a beautiful soul who has freely chosen to gift the practice of yoga to millions of people around the world. By supporting her business through the FWFG app, you are supporting a community of people dedicated to caring for themselves and each other.

Find What Feels Good. I love this app and the community. I am so grateful to the FWFG team and the effort they have put into this app. It is very user friendly and accessible. I look forward to using this app to help my practice grow more and more.

So GOOD. Adriene is a master at conveying all levels of yoga practice. Her creative collaboration is featured in the FWFG app. The app is easy to manage and useful for both members and non/members. Although, I would highly recommend becoming a member if you are looking the enhance your yoga journey!
My most treasured app. YWA/FWFG is essential to my health and happiness. Thank you Adriene, ❤️

Best value for yoga hands down!. I have been a loyal follower of Adriene for several years, but it took me a little while to commit to the annual FWFG membership. Now that I have, I know I will be a member for life! Not only is Adriene an absolute angel on earth and leads practices in the most loving way, the app is so beautiful and well organized that it is super easy to find a practice that works for you every day without hassle!
If you’re wondering if you should get it. Don’t hesitate. Worth it, high quality, deliberately and mindfully made content delivered to a community you need to be a part of.
Awesome. Adriene and her practices are awesome - there is something for everyone!

A plethora of juicy tools to expand self. This isn’t an exercise app- I mean yes, you do get fit from doing Yoga/Pilates but this one can be so much more than that, if it appeals to you. There are fitness focused videos for sure but also mindful practice incorporated into the yoga and meditation resources plus general teachings on how to practice breath and cultivating inner harmony. Adrianne has a free YouTube channel with a lot of content but the app is add free, organized better and has greater content. I can’t recommend it enough. I use it everyday and my life has shifted in a huge way- for the better. Thank you Adrianne and community for creating this!!
Simply Amazing. FWFG has been life changing for me! Adriene and team are amazing! 5 stars is not enough! ❤️🙏🏼

Top rated. I don’t like spending money on apps but I have been following Adrienne for several years and her program is the absolute best!! She inspires a wonderful much needed calming effect in this crazy world. 
I recommend heartily!

Transformational. I use this every day. She has 10, 15… 60 minute practices some restorative, breath practices, meditation, active practices, strength building. Something to fit every day. There is an easy calendar to follow, a book club and lots of opportunities to improve. Her mantras and affirmations along with the yoga transform your mood.

Thank you Adriene and Team. Finding this community and cultivating a daily yoga practice has been nothing short of life-changing. Your compassion, your gentle kindness coupled with a terrific sense of humor has made yoga available to me and many others worldwide! FWFG and it’s exclusive content is the best investment I can make is myself and in this community!
Love this app. I have never been able to focus on self care and daily practice until using this app! Encourage everyone to join the party!

This app makes integrating YWA into your life easy. I discovered the app during COVID. I use it exclusively and daily now. It makes all the practices available and organized and searchable. I have it on my Chromebook and phone and I can do Yoga when I travel. I mix up using the calendars and revisit the series - like the 30 day collections. This year I started with the very first one and progressed through the years. Also if some are short I can easily do the next one in the series right then. It is so easy to use. You can filter by length, focus area, easy or advanced, and various other factors to find the perfect practice and mark your favorites. You also get lots of extras such as Off the Mat - recipes and other healthy living videos. HIGHLY recommend.

Life-Changing App!. Once of the best decisions I’ve ever made was downloading this app and joining the FWFG community! It puts the highest quality at-home yoga experience right at my fingertips, and I’m forever grateful. 🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽

Genuine, grounding and loving. Every time I practice with Adriene, I feel a gush of honesty bringing me closer to light.. It truly feels good. Thank you for your integrity and thank you for your love, loving you back🙏🏽

Start somewhere 🌱. Never done yoga, curious, think it’s only for girls, or maybe you think it’s just to easy or not for you…. I’d ask you to just try it. Take a gander and I promise if you’re really wanting something you’ll find it here. There’s an app called Kula as well. It’s one big happy family trying to help each other along this rough journey. This is the only at home Yoga practice I’ve done ever and I have no intention on changing that. Not only does this app offer Yoga but offer meditation, talks on chakras, chat rooms for special groups with particular likes. I mean this app has got it all. Love Adriene , the crew and of course Benji. Thank you for all you have done and all you continue to do🌱🦋💫

Life changing. I began paying for the app to honor the work that Adriene has done to help people gain access to yoga at home. I was watching and practicing with her on YouTube for free everyday for a couple years before deciding to try the FWFG app. It is worth every penny! Her monthly vlogs are so heartfelt and inspiring. I love how she reads a poem and does a Benji cam every month. But most of all I love her authenticity. The app is well organized and helps by allowing you to mark favorites, follow her monthly calendar, or choose a practice for the day based on many different criteria such as time, body part, or skill level. I highly recommend it.

FWFG. Hands down the best at home yoga practice there is. Adriene’s calm, funny, real way of “teaching” yoga is perfect. No attitude, no judgement just sheer taking care of yourself. Try one of her 30 day programs and you will be hooked. The community she created is also as close to home and comfortable as being curled up on your couch with a good book, glass of wine and a crackling fire. IG highly recommend it.

Game Changer!!. This app is incredible. Adriene and her team have created a vast collection of incredible tools to help you connect to your body and yourself. With a variety of yoga practices, curated playlists and calendars, meditations, Pilates, personal blogs, recipes, as well as physical therapy and yoga therapy segments, FWFG has it all. You will not regret using this app. It will change your game in the best of ways!
Yoga. I love the FWFG app!! I’ve be practicing with Adriene since the beginning. I love the videos that you can only get on the app. There are so many gems.

Love Yoga with Adriane. This has changed my life for the better. The at home yoga practice is perfect for me. Adriane is so fun, yet professional and calming. She has all levels of yoga. Check it out!

Life Giving, Life Changing. Adriene is such a calm, wise, sweet soul who has taught me so much, not only about yoga but also about living a life a presence. I highly recommend joining her FWFG community if you want more peace, presence and acceptance in your life. She is such a wonderful role model for us all. Thank you for all you do Adriene!

The best. Life changing even.. Adrienne is amazing. She makes the practice open and welcoming to anyone at any level or time in life. She is friendly and genuine and gentle in her teachings. Literally changed my life after wanting to start yoga for years but I didn’t know where to begin. FWFG has been the starting point and has carried me through my practice for a year now and as I gain more knowledge and flexibility the practices grow with me. If you’re on the fence get it. She feels like a best friend and Benji is too perfect

A gentle reminder to take care of yourself. Main points: value for the money, few notifications, quality content 

It’s important you know that I abhor paid app subscriptions. I usually find it a waste of money with little to no actual value. That said, FWFG membership is worth far more than the $9.99 I pay per month. I have yet to practice daily, but the occasional notifications of new videos and Adriene’s monthly vlogs remind me to return to my mat. I have yet to do a practice on FWFG that I didn’t like. If you’re on the fence about whether or not to subscribe, please do!
next level. Yoga with Adriene is awesome, and being a member of FWFG is worth it! The extra material, the excellent search features and just how it is all organized and presented are terrific!

Best YOGA app. Adriene is the premier yoga instructor. Her cues are exceptional and the overall teaching and encouragements are top notch. Having never done yoga (Pilates for 20 years), I joined in her annual January daily practices and then joined FWFG. This journey has been life changing. As I grow stronger, Adriene is always there to challenge me with something new. I highly recommend this app. Huge variety of practices to choose from. Don’t delay. Go for it!

So Worth it!. I started doing Adriene’s YouTube videos in April 2020 as a way to ease my stress about the pandemic. After one year of doing yoga regularly, I took the plunge and signed up with FWFG. And I renewed it one year later, no question! I wake up most mornings, looking forward to the day, as I start them off with yoga with Adriene. You get more intermediate videos with the app, and I like have a catalog of my favorites. Her training is kind and positive, and I love her music choices with the FWFG videos. This purchase really is worth it if you have a home practice, so give it a try!
She”s a true angel. Her calming practices and breath practice have made my life better. Just yesterday I listened to one of her medications on a crowded regional jet to abort a panic attack, Amazing!

Life changing. On so many levels this is an amazing program. Adrian is real in her love and care of this yoga community. I am older and remain well above an average active lifestyle due to my strength and flexibility from regular practice here. I am also very tight with my $ and believe me becoming a member is well worth it. Mentally and physically you can find it here!

Love it. Find What Feels Good is much improved from a few years ago. The functionality is now great. I love that you can create your own playlists and save your favorite practices. It’s wonderful that they’ve added guest instructors to broaden their offerings which truly provides a well-rounded yoga app (and so much more). Another feature I use frequently is the built-in calendar with the recommended practices for each day. It also provides space for you to do a quick journal. If you want to change the recommended practice, you can schedule whichever one you want. And it keeps track of what days you’ve completed a practice. All in all, highly recommend, especially if you are already familiar with YWA ❤️

No one responds to help desk. I set up my acct and set up a plan on my calendar. The next day everything was gone. I reached out to help 4 days ago and no response. I had high hopes for this but I guess I’ll stick to YouTube.

Worth paying for!. I have been using Yoga With Adriene since 2016. I love her You Tube Channel! If you’re new to YWA and/or new to yoga, her channel is an excellent place to start. However, once you’ve practiced with her for a while and find yourself wanting to advance, the app is the place to go. I LOVE the longer more advanced videos available here. Plus, I think my favorite thing is how the videos end and it’s silent… no YT adds! Shavasana as it should be. Worth every penny!

Adriene is great but app is frustrating for the price. This is a review for the app only and not the content because 90% of the content is free on YouTube so anyone can see how great the videos are. The app currently has a rating of 4.9/5 because everyone loves Adriene, but I wish people would rate the actual app so maybe they would fix it or even add features (like the ability to see if/when you last completed a video or to make notes for yourself about each video to track your progress)! The app is glitchy and slow. The search function is a complete mystery how it comes up with some videos and not others, and the videos are not tagged thoroughly so the filtering function only gives a few of the applicable results. The calendar is the primary reason I pay so much (as I said, most of the content is available free), and recently it has started marking a lot of my scheduled videos as “missed” even when I didn’t miss them, which leaves a red X on my calendar for that day even if I complete the video and 6 others that day. This is discouraging in my yoga journey and seems counter to the goals of the app. If it were free, i wouldn’t complain, but it’s the same price as netflix with way less content, so I draw the line at an app that shames me about not timing a scheduled practice exactly right when I do at least 2 videos every day. I love Yoga With Adriene, it has literally changed my life over the 2 years I’ve been a FWFG member, but the app developer they hired did the minimum they could for the app to be functional. It has too many users to be the quality of a local public utilities company’s app.

ipad view is so small. When I first downloaded the FWFG app six months ago, I was able to view the videos in expanded view and it would almost take up my entire laptop screen. A couple months ago I updated the app and ever since, the viewing space is so strictly made for ipad that viewing on my laptop makes the content so small and hard to see. I was hopeful that they would quickly revert back to the previous video screen size, but they haven't and so I've barely been using the app even though I pay for it monthly. It doesn't make a lot of sense to want to watch yoga classes on a mobile device anyway, since you're having to watch the instructor as you're doing the poses. 
aside from this critique, the app is pretty good. I love all the instructors and YWA has truly changed my life and helped me heal. I just hope they make the app more accessible soon.
Love!. I love this app. I use it daily for years. But this last update makes the app switch to vertical every time I try to watch it now on my ipad. Please fix this bug and my frustration? Thank you!

Crashes. Love the app and love Yoga with Adriene, but this last update messed up the app. I can’t open it at all on my iPad, it crashes immediately. I’m hoping they fix this soon, otherwise I’ll have to cancel my membership if I’m not able to use the app.
Required purchase. None of the videos are viewable. You must purchase membership to see.
Enjoying the app. we need help tracking what's the next episode in the list. It doesn't remember the last episode to suggest the next one

Yoga- Great. App- not so much.. I love doing yoga with Adriene, but the app makes it a pain. It’s glitchy, and using the app on the TV is even worse- it will disconnect but still be connected somehow, so you’re still watching but can’t access any of the controls. It’s so much more simpler to use on YouTube, which makes you wonder why you’re paying for the app. I do love the organization of the classes- particular when I have a time limit or a desire to do flow or gentle practices, but that’s also accessible on YouTube.

Life. I have been working with Adriene for years and I love it. SOMETIMES SHE TALKS A LITTLE MUCH!!! But by the time your done you realize you just did a 20 second plank and you’re too proud of yourself to be mad anymore lol

The one issue I had was fixed. Great app, great content. I found this is a valuable addition to my life and I like having the app so I can tap the source directly rather than accessing content on YouTube. Keep up the good work developers.

Yoga for everyone!. I’ve been with Adriene (YWA) since 2015 and love, love, love her videos. While you can watch her videos on YouTube for free, this app offers so much more. There are many paths to follow, series, monthly calendars, meditation and even other teachers. Such a small price to pay. The only reason I took one star off was to get attention of the developer to add a way to view all the content I have not yet watched or completed. You can see the ones you have completed (as well as your marked favorites and ones downloaded), but I’m sure I’m not alone in wanting to work my way thru ALL the videos. A way to view them would be great!
Feels so good. Best yoga ever. I recommend using this app daily to learn, feel better and enjoy!
Following for seven years now. She makes me giggle and offers compassion when you really need that support when you’re in a rough spot. Always feel better after taking her classes! Enjoy

The best app from the best teacher.. I absolutely love this app, I’ve been doing videos almost daily for about 9 months now and Adriene has the best videos. I feel the most connected to my breath and body and I feel good about myself again. I finally last month decided to subscribe and give back because I watched her YouTube videos so much that I thought I’d subscribe. I love the calendar that automatically updates my progress, and it’s nice to not have to look through videos and decide which one to do. The extra meditations included are such a bonus as well. I’m so grateful for the effort Adriene puts into her craft, and how much she has supported me through my journey.

No better app, teacher, or way to personally grow your yoga practice. YWA/FWFG has been a true revelation and a joy for me and my at home yoga practice. Adrienne is an amazing teacher and person and the membership gives you access to an enormous and ever expanding library of yoga and meditation practices that you simply can not find elsewhere for the price. It’s super accessible for people of all experience levels and backgrounds, and she really goes the extra mile in helping you find what works for you as opposed to just hitting “the pose”. She focuses on increasing YOUR awareness of YOUR body and YOUR breathing in and out of poses. She gives you Information about the objective of each pose which allows you to work toward that objective while finding what feels good in that pose for your body at that moment. She focuses on how you move into and out of positions with coordination of your breathing and movement increasing your attention and decreasing injury. After a few classes, you become aware of finding what feels good and what doesn’t as your muscles and bones change position. Practicing awareness of your body on the yoga mat crosses over to improving awareness of your body during movement in the daily activities of life. To anyone who has endured physical pain or difficulty moving, you understand that this awareness leads to physical and mental freedom....to feeling empowered again.....to feeling like yourself but moving with the ease and power that you had 10 years ago.
